metadata.name: hook_vault
metadata.description: Bordrless hook vault: a launchpad coin's token hook sends its cuts to up to three slots, each with a policy fixed before the launch (burn, sell for SOL to a fixed wallet, or sell and buy-and-burn another token), run by anyone under a port of the companion's buyback guards.

instructions.name: create_vault
docs: Makes the vault of `mint` (not created yet; it signs): the coin's hook, the slots' policies,
the bounty, the sell limits and the interval, all fixed for good. Remaining: each
`SellBuyBurn` slot's pool and that pool's launch.

accounts.name: mint
docs: The coin's mint, a fresh keypair: it signs here, so only whoever holds it can make its vault
(nobody can make one first and route the coin's cuts to their own wallet), and its launch
later (exactly as the companion's `create`). It must not exist yet (no data, the system
program's): the vault, and so every slot's policy, is fixed before the coin is launched.

instructions.name: execute
docs: Anyone: runs slot `i`: burns its coin, or sells a slice of it (or waits), paying the SOL to
the slot's wallet or keeping it for the slot's buy.

accounts.name: cranker
docs: Whoever sends it; paid the bounty (as SOL), and pays any holding a step creates.

instructions.name: execute_buy
docs: Anyone: a `SellBuyBurn` slot buys the other token with the SOL its sells left (or waits),
and burns it.

accounts.name: cranker
docs: Whoever sends it; paid the bounty (as SOL), and pays any holding a step creates.

instructions.name: migrate_vault_to_native
docs: The upgrade authority, with the DEX paused and the coin's launch native: turns the vault
native (each slot's pending SOL unwrapped onto its owner). Idempotent.

instructions.name: open_vault
docs: The vault's creator (or a sender with the mint's keypair signing), once the coin is launched
with the vault's hook: creates the slots' holdings (the sender pays) and sets the reference
prices (the sells': the coin's pool price, at most its launch's opening price).

accounts.name: sender
docs: The vault's creator (`Vault::creator`, who paid for it), or anyone with the coin's mint
keypair signing too; pays the holdings' rent (and each selling slot owner's).

accounts.name: launch
docs: launchpad owns it).

accounts.name: mint
docs: keypair, as at `create_vault`), which lets a sender other than the creator open.

instructions.name: retire
docs: Anyone, after 60 days in which slot `i` did not run: burns its SOL (to the incinerator) and,
with `burn_coin`, its coin. Nobody receives anything.

accounts.name: cranker
docs: Whoever sends it; paid the bounty (as SOL), and pays any holding a step creates.

instructions.name: revert_vault_to_bridged
docs: The upgrade authority, with the DEX paused: turns a native vault back (each slot's pending
SOL wrapped into its holding). Idempotent.

errors.name: BountyTooHigh
errors.msg: the bounty is at most 1% of what a step moves

errors.name: BadMaxSell
errors.msg: one sell takes from 1 to 100 basis points of the pool's quote side

errors.name: BadInterval
errors.msg: the interval is from a minute to 30 days

errors.name: BadHookCut
errors.msg: the hook's declared cut of the vault's sell is at most 50%

errors.name: BadSlots
errors.msg: a vault has one to three slots, each with a policy

errors.name: BadTarget
errors.msg: a slot's target does not fit its policy

errors.name: BadPool
errors.msg: the pool to buy from must be another launchpad token's pool quoted in bridged SOL, without holder rewards

errors.name: BadHook
errors.msg: the hook must be a program of the coin's own, not a protocol program

errors.name: MissingAccount
errors.msg: an account the step needs was not passed

errors.name: AlreadyOpen
errors.msg: the vault is open already

errors.name: NotOpen
errors.msg: the vault is not open yet

errors.name: LaunchMissing
errors.msg: the coin has no launch yet

errors.name: WrongHook
errors.msg: the coin's launch or mint runs another hook than the vault's

errors.name: WrongSlot
errors.msg: no such slot

errors.name: WrongSlotOwner
errors.msg: the slot's owner is not that slot's address

errors.name: NotDue
errors.msg: not yet: the launch's first minute, or the slot's interval, has not passed

errors.name: NothingToDo
errors.msg: nothing to do yet

errors.name: NoQuote
errors.msg: the pool gives no quote for this amount

errors.name: MathOverflow
errors.msg: math overflow

errors.name: NotSellBuyBurn
errors.msg: only a sell-and-buy-and-burn slot buys

errors.name: NotRetirable
errors.msg: a slot is retired only after 60 days with no execution

errors.name: HookRegistry
errors.msg: the hook's registry is missing, not the hook's, or out of bounds

errors.name: MintExists
errors.msg: a vault is made before its coin: the mint must not exist yet

errors.name: DuplicatePool
errors.msg: two buy slots of one vault can't buy on the same pool

errors.name: BadWallet
errors.msg: the wallet paid can't take SOL: a program, a reserved key, or an address of the vault's own

errors.name: NoRoom
errors.msg: the bought token's wallet cap leaves no room for a buy

errors.name: NotOpener
errors.msg: only the vault's creator (who paid for it) or the coin's mint keypair opens a vault

errors.name: NotUpgradeAuthority
errors.msg: not the hook vault program's upgrade authority

errors.name: DexNotPaused
errors.msg: the DEX must be paused for this

errors.name: LaunchNotNative
errors.msg: the coin's launch is not native yet: migrate its pool and launch first

types.name: BuyWaited
docs: A buy that waited: the token's price was more than 3% above the buy's reference. The wait uses
up the slot's turn to buy.

types.name: CreateVaultArgs
docs: Arguments of `create_vault`. None of them can change afterwards: no instruction writes them.

fields.name: hook
docs: The coin's own token hook: the program its `LaunchConfig` names (`custom_hook`). It sends the
cuts; `open_vault` checks the launch and the mint run it.

fields.name: slots
docs: One to three slots, in the order the hook names them.

fields.name: bounty_bps
docs: The crank's pay: at most 100 basis points of the SOL a step moves.

fields.name: max_sell_bps
docs: The most one sell takes of the pool's quote side: 1 to 100 basis points (and never more
than the launch's `pool_share_bps`).

fields.name: interval
docs: The least time between two sells of a slot (and two buys): a minute to 30 days.

fields.name: max_hook_cut_bps
docs: The most the coin's own hook may cut from the vault's sell: at most 5,000 basis points.

types.name: Launch
docs: A launch at `["launch", mint]`.

fields.name: version
docs: Layout version.

fields.name: bump
docs: Bump.

fields.name: mint
docs: The token.

fields.name: creator
docs: Who launched it.

fields.name: pool
docs: The pool on the DEX.

fields.name: quote_mint
docs: The quote mint.

fields.name: status
docs: `STATUS_CURVE` or `STATUS_GRADUATED`.

fields.name: creator_fee_bps
docs: Creator fee on every swap, in basis points of the quote.

fields.name: lp_fee_bps
docs: LP fee of the pool.

fields.name: sniper_window_secs
docs: Sniper window.

fields.name: sniper_start_bps
docs: LP fee at the start of the window.

fields.name: virtual_quote
docs: Virtual quote reserve at opening.

fields.name: virtual_base
docs: Virtual base reserve.

fields.name: graduation_quote
docs: Real quote reserve at which the launch graduates.

fields.name: curve_tokens
docs: Tokens on the curve.

fields.name: reserve_tokens
docs: Tokens reserved for graduation.

fields.name: reserve_holding
docs: The launch's holding of the token (the reserve, then nothing).

fields.name: quote_holding
docs: The launch's holding of the quote (creator fees).

fields.name: lp_holding
docs: The launch's holding of the pool's LP mint (locked for ever).

fields.name: created_at
docs: Creation time.

fields.name: graduated_at
docs: Graduation time (0 until then).

fields.name: creator_fees_accrued
docs: Creator fees taken so far.

fields.name: creator_fees_claimed
docs: Creator fees claimed so far.

fields.name: graduation_topup
docs: Base added to the pool at graduation.

fields.name: graduation_burned
docs: Base burned at graduation.

fields.name: rules
docs: The token rules, fixed at launch.

fields.name: modules
docs: The kit modules of `rules` (0: no kit, no token hook).

fields.name: kit_config
docs: `PDA(["kit", mint], KIT_ID)`, derived whatever the modules (the pool hook's fixed key).

fields.name: holder_vault
docs: `holding(quote_mint, kit_config)`, derived whatever the modules: the kit's reward vault
when holder rewards are on, where holder fees go.

fields.name: kit_caller_bump
docs: Bump of `PDA(["kit-caller", mint], LAUNCH_ID)`, which signs the kit's `init` and
`graduate`; 0 without a kit.

fields.name: creator_unlock_at
docs: The creator wallet unlocks at this time; 0 when off.

fields.name: early_window_end
docs: Buys from the pool before this time are locked; 0 when off.

fields.name: early_unlock_at
docs: ... until this time; 0 when off.

fields.name: creator_bought
docs: The creator's own first buy took the normal LP fee inside the sniper window (once).

fields.name: holder_fees_accrued
docs: Holder fees taken so far (bridged SOL, into the holder vault).

fields.name: burned_on_trades
docs: Tokens burned on trades (both sides; not the graduation burn).

fields.name: config
docs: The `LaunchConfig` the launch was made from; the default key for inline rules.

fields.name: custom_hook
docs: The creator's own token hook (from the config), when the token has one. It runs on every
transfer, mint and burn its flags name; nobody vets its code.

fields.name: custom_hook_flags
docs: The custom hook's flags; 0 without one.

fields.name: author_share_bps
docs: The config author's share of the creator fee (basis points of it), from a listed config
whose author is not the launch's creator; 0 otherwise. Fixed at launch: every claim pays
the author this part of what it takes.

fields.name: author_fees_paid
docs: Creator fees paid to the config's author so far (quote).

fields.name: reserved
docs: Reserved. `reserved[0..4]` are the custom hook's SOL cut caps from the config
([`Launch::quote_cut`]), `reserved[4..12]` the SOL it has taken so far (part of
`creator_fees_accrued`), `reserved[12]` the bump of the hook's `["state", mint]` and
`reserved[13]` of the launchpad's `["quote-cut", hook]` signer; zeros for every launch made
before (`docs/quote-cut.md`). `reserved[14..16]` are the partner's share of the creator fee
and `reserved[16]` the bump of the config's [`PartnerFee`], from the config
([`Launch::partner_share_bps`], `docs/partner-fee.md`); zeros for every launch made before.

types.name: LaunchRules
docs: The rules a launch fixes for its token (`docs/hooks-v2.md` §5.1): what the pool hook takes on
each side, and the kit modules the token gets. Holder rewards are on when either holder fee is
above 0.

fields.name: holder_fee_buy_bps
docs: Holder fee on buys, from the quote input, paid to the holder vault.

fields.name: holder_fee_sell_bps
docs: Holder fee on sells, from the quote output after the protocol fee.

fields.name: burn_buy_bps
docs: Burn on buys, from the token output.

fields.name: burn_sell_bps
docs: Burn on sells, from the token input.

fields.name: max_wallet_bps
docs: Max wallet in basis points of the supply; 0 = off. Lifts at graduation.

fields.name: creator_lock_secs
docs: Creator wallet lock, counted from the launch; 0 = off.

fields.name: early_window_secs
docs: Early-buyer window, counted from the launch; 0 = off.

fields.name: early_lock_secs
docs: Early-buyer unlock, counted from the launch; above `early_window_secs` (0 when the lock is
off).

types.name: PendingPaid
docs: `SellForSol`: a payment held back earlier, paid now.

types.name: SellWaited
docs: A sell that waited: the price was more than 3% below the reference. The wait uses up the slot's
turn: its next sell (or wait) is an interval later.

fields.name: reference
docs: The reference the price was held to, and where it is now.

types.name: Slot
docs: One slot of a vault: its policy, fixed at `create_vault`, and its running state.
Fixed layout (no `Option`): an unused slot is all zeros with `policy == policy::UNUSED`.

fields.name: policy
docs: `policy::BURN`, `SELL_FOR_SOL`, `SELL_BUY_BURN`, or `UNUSED`.

fields.name: target
docs: `SellForSol`: the wallet paid. `SellBuyBurn`: the DEX pool of the token bought and burned (a
launchpad pool quoted in bridged SOL). The default key for `Burn`.

fields.name: owner_bump
docs: Bump of the slot's owner, `PDA(["slot", mint, [i]])`.

fields.name: max_cut_bps
docs: `SellBuyBurn` with a custom-hook token: the most that token's own hook may cut from the
slot's buy, as the creator declared it (basis points, at most `MAX_HOOK_CUT_BPS`): the buy's
`min_out` is loosened by that cut and Bordrless's share of it. 0 otherwise.

fields.name: last_at
docs: The slot's last sell (or its burn, or its retirement); 0 before the first. The next sell is
an interval later.

fields.name: waited_at
docs: The last time the slot's sell waited (the price more than 3% below the reference); 0 before
the first. The next attempt is `MIN_INTERVAL` later: a wait and a sell never share a
transaction (or a block), and a one-block dip costs the slot a minute, not an interval.

fields.name: reference_price
docs: The sell's reference price (quote per base unit times `PRICE_SCALE`): set to the pool's price
at `open_vault`, raised only by a sell, lowered toward the price only while a sell waits.

fields.name: reference_at
docs: When the sell's reference clock last restarted: at `open_vault`, at every sale, and at every
wait that stepped the reference. A wait steps it once for each interval since then.

fields.name: pending_sol
docs: Bridged SOL the slot holds for later: `SellBuyBurn`'s proceeds, to buy with;
`SellForSol`'s payment to an empty wallet that it could not yet open (below a wallet's
rent-exempt minimum).

fields.name: buy_reference
docs: The buy's reference price (of the token bought): set at `open_vault`, lowered only by a buy,
raised toward the price only while a buy waits (the companion's buyback reference, as is).

fields.name: buy_reference_at
docs: When the buy's reference clock last restarted (at `open_vault`, every buy, and every wait
that stepped it).

fields.name: buy_last_at
docs: The slot's last buy; 0 before the first.

fields.name: buy_waited_at
docs: The last time the slot's buy waited; the next attempt is `MIN_INTERVAL` later.

fields.name: sold
docs: Coin sold so far.

fields.name: sol_out
docs: SOL the sells brought in so far (before bounties).

fields.name: x_burned
docs: The other token bought and burned so far (`SellBuyBurn`).

fields.name: burned
docs: Coin burned so far (`Burn`, and `retire`).

fields.name: bounties
docs: Bounties paid so far (lamports).

types.name: SlotArgs
docs: A slot's policy as `create_vault` takes it.

fields.name: policy
docs: `policy::BURN`, `SELL_FOR_SOL` or `SELL_BUY_BURN`.

fields.name: target
docs: `SellForSol`: the wallet paid. `SellBuyBurn`: the pool of the token bought and burned. The
default key for `Burn`.

fields.name: max_cut_bps
docs: `SellBuyBurn` of a token with its own custom hook: the most that hook may cut from the
slot's buy (basis points, at most 5,000), included in the buy's `min_out`. 0 otherwise.

fields.name: spent
docs: SOL spent (after the bounty).

fields.name: burned
docs: The other token bought and burned (with any of it someone had sent the slot's owner, burned
first).

types.name: SlotPolicy
docs: A slot as `create_vault` fixed it.

fields.name: max_cut_bps
docs: `SellBuyBurn` of a custom-hook token: the most that token's hook may cut from the buy.

fields.name: sol_burned
docs: SOL sent to the incinerator.

fields.name: coin_burned
docs: Coin burned.

fields.name: sold
docs: Coin sold.

fields.name: got
docs: SOL it brought (bridged), before the bounty.

fields.name: paid
docs: SOL paid to the slot's wallet (`SellForSol`); 0 for `SellBuyBurn`, or while it waits.

fields.name: pending_sol
docs: What the slot holds for later after this sell.

fields.name: price
docs: The pool's price before the sell, and the reference after it.

types.name: Vault
docs: A coin's vault, `PDA(["vault", mint])`.

fields.name: version
docs: Layout version.

fields.name: bump
docs: Bump.

fields.name: mint
docs: The coin.

fields.name: hook
docs: The coin's own token hook (its launch's `custom_hook`), which sends the vault its cuts.

fields.name: creator
docs: Who paid for the vault (informational).

fields.name: n_slots
docs: Slots in use: `slots[..n_slots]`.

fields.name: bounty_bps
docs: The crank's pay, in basis points of the SOL a sell or a buy moves.

fields.name: max_sell_bps
docs: The most one sell takes of the pool's quote side (basis points), and never more than the
launch's `pool_share_bps`.

fields.name: interval
docs: The least time between two sells of a slot, and between two buys.

fields.name: max_hook_cut_bps
docs: The most the coin's own hook may cut from the vault's sell, as its creator declared it: the
sell's `min_out` is loosened by that cut and Bordrless's share of it, and by nothing more.

fields.name: opened
docs: `open_vault` has run: the slots' holdings exist and their references are set.

fields.name: last_activity_at
docs: The last time any instruction changed the vault.

fields.name: reserved
docs: Reserved.

fields.name: slot_owners
docs: The slots' owners, `PDA(["slot", mint, [i]])`: their holdings of the coin are what the hook
names as delta targets once the vault is open.

fields.name: price
docs: The price the sells' references start at: the coin's pool price, or its launch's opening
price when the pool is above it (so nobody can open a vault at a pumped price).
